What are the cleaning steps in the instr: Daily care: rinse with cold water; wash with mild, unscented, water-based soap; clear the suction holes; rinse away all soap residue. Between cycles: sterilise in boiling water for three to five minutes; keep the cup away from the base of the pot.
How much does each size hold?: Small: roughly 15 ml to the rim. Large: approximately 28–30 ml.
Besides mild unscented water-based soap,: Avoid: Bleach, vinegar, tea tree oil, hydrogen peroxide, antibacterial soaps and harsh rubbing alcohol
